Subject: Developer sandbox signup — looking for a technical walkthrough

Hi Karthik,

We just spun up a sandbox using the docs quickstart CTA and I have a couple of devs who want to validate how Redwood would fit into our inference pipeline (throughput + token cost is what we're most concerned about). Our trial org is under Buildware.

Would someone from your engineering team be available for a 30–45 minute technical walkthrough next week? Ideally we'd cover:
- basic onboarding+auth flow
- model variants and quantization guidance for our LLMs
- how prefix/KV caching works with short sessions

I can do afternoons (PST) any day Tue–Thu. If easier, point me at a calendar link.

Thanks,
Samir

I'll be on the call along with our Senior ML Engineer (joining as a listener). Looking forward to the walkthrough.
